list_directory.description: List files in the mapped folder; links outside it are not followed.

read_files.description: Read UTF-8 text files, optionally selecting a line range. Size limits are configurable in tools.json.

write_file.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 file inside the mapped folder.

edit_file.description: Replace exactly one occurrence of old_text. Missing or ambiguous matches fail without modifying the file.

run_command.description: Run a PowerShell command with its working directory inside the mapped folder. NOT a security sandbox: commands have the current Windows user permissions and can access other locations.

search_files.description: Search filenames or UTF-8 text using literal matching. Supports basic glob filtering and snapshot pagination. Hidden and generated folders are skipped by default; returns explicit truncation/skip counts.

manage_files.description: Create a directory, move/rename without overwriting, or move an item into the project .webcoding-trash folder. Delete requires confirm_delete=true; root operations and permanent deletion are forbidden.

start_process.description: Start a persistent foreground command in the mapped folder. Returns an owned process_id and initial logs. Use this for servers and watchers, not run_command. Child processes are stopped when the service exits.

read_process_output.description: Read incremental output from an owned process_id using an absolute character cursor. Can wait for new output or process exit. Reports dropped old logs explicitly. Omit process_id to list this service's tasks.

stop_process.description: Stop only a task created by this service, including its child process tree. Accepts an owned process_id, never an arbitrary system PID.

read_image.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/BMP/GIF file inside the mapped folder and return an MCP image block, resized if needed. No URL fetching. Requires a client that accepts image tool results.

capture_window.description: List windows or capture one selected by hwnd, PID, process name or title. Ambiguous matches return candidates. Does not activate/restore windows unless allow_activate=true. Screen capture requires explicit activation permission; protected/minimized/GPU windows may fail or be incomplete.
